create_softmax_distribution: create a Softmax distribution from logits with a custom temperature parameter
sample_softmax_distribution: sample from a Softmax distribution using scaled logits and temperature
get_softmax_temperature: get the temperature parameter from a Softmax distribution instance
get_softmax_unscaled_logits: get the unscaled logits before temperature scaling from a Softmax distribution
index_softmax_distribution: index into a batched Softmax distribution to get a sliced Softmax instance
